description: Na₅WNO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one N and four O atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.40 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent WNO₄ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.54 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one N and four O atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.88 Å. There are two shorter (2.27 Å) and two longer (2.29 Å) Na-O bond lengths. W is bonded to one N and four O atoms to form distorted WNO₄ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. The W-N bond length is 1.81 Å. There are two shorter (1.98 Å) and two longer (1.99 Å) W-O bond lengths. N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na and one W atom. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one W atom to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₅W octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-43°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one W atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₅W octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-43°.
